title: Evaluating Jev on Arabic: Comparing Decision Models and LLMs Across Arabic Tasks and Dialects
abstract: arXiv:2611.10802v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How does Jev compare with other systems on Arabic tasks, and how does its performance change between Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and dialects? We evaluate 67 systems, including 47 decision models and 20 large language models (LLMs), on 43 tasks across 9 task families using a shared zero-shot protocol. The Arabic-focused frozen suite includes English controls in three parallel resources, which we also remove in a separate descriptive comparison. Jev 1.14.0 achieves a mean task-primary metric of 69.24 on a scale multiplied by 100, compared with 68.77 for Jev 1.13.0 and 71.81 for Gemma-4-31B, the highest-scoring system on this aggregate. Removing the recorded English controls, repeated cross-task items or both leaves the full system order unchanged. Relative performance and gains between Jev versions vary across task families. In content-matched comparisons within Jev 1.14.0, pooled dialect-minus-MSA accuracy gaps range from -7.9

translated_title: 评估Jev在阿拉伯语上的表现：跨阿拉伯语任务与方言比较决策模型和大语言模型
translated_abstract: Jev与其他系统在阿拉伯语任务上的比较结果如何？其性能在现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）与各方言之间又有何变化？我们采用统一的零样本协议，在9个任务族的43个任务上评估了67个系统，其中包括47个决策模型和20个大语言模型（LLM）。该以阿拉伯语为核心的冻结测试套件在三个平行资源中包含了英语对照组，我们还在一项单独的描述性比较中将其移除。Jev 1.14.0取得了69.24的平均任务主指标（按百分制计算），相比之下Jev 1.13.0为68.77，而Gemma-4-31B为71.81，是此综合评测中得分最高的系统。移除已记录的英语对照组、重复的跨任务条目或同时移除两者，均不会改变系统的整体排序。Jev各版本之间的相对性能和提升幅度在不同任务族之间有所差异。在Jev 1.14.0内部进行的内容匹配比较中，方言相对MSA的合并准确率差距范围达到-7.9……
tldr: 该研究在9个任务族的43个阿拉伯语任务上对67个系统（含Jev决策模型与20个LLM）进行零样本评测，发现Jev 1.14.0（69.24）表现具有竞争力但略逊于Gemma-4-31B（71.81），且各方言相对现代标准阿拉伯语存在明显的准确率差距。
en_tdlr: This zero-shot evaluation of 67 systems (including Jev decision models and 20 LLMs) across 43 Arabic tasks in 9 task families shows that Jev 1.14.0 (69.24) is competitive but slightly trails Gemma-4-31B (71.81), with notable pooled accuracy gaps between Arabic dialects and Modern Standard Arabic.
